protocol.comparison: model AP minus max(size_log_dimension AP, size_spline_gate AP) within every identical bootstrap draw

historical_family.definition: Every previously scored status=ok, non-diagnostic exact-LOFO record, one composite size comparison per record.

protocol.pass_rule: The raw paired 95% lower bound is >0 and the Holm-adjusted two-sided bootstrap p-value is <0.05.

shci_confirmatory_family.definition: All SHCI_var cells x two primary models x full-class and success+miss treatments x with/without identifier columns.
